title: Biomass register — October 2026: generation 2025 ahead of usual (+13 % weight), −2 % stock left; 6 kg+ expected 15.5 % in November
lines: Harvest in October 2026: 168 kt gutted (+6 % on October 2025), average fish 4.26 kg (4.09 a year earlier). Biomass at sea 804 kt gutted (+1 %), 91 % of the MTB (zones 1–13, live weight).
Generation 2025, being harvested: 3.67 kg gutted on average, +13 % against the same generation stage of the past 5 years (ahead of usual); 452 kt gutted left at sea, −2 %.
Generation 2026, next in line: 1.08 kg gutted on average, +8 % against the same generation stage of the past 5 years (ahead of usual).
Mortality: 0.83 % of the stock in the month (1.27 % a year earlier).
Sizes expected (share of harvest volume): November 2026: 6 kg+ 15.5 %, 5–6 kg 20.6 % (revised +0.7 pt from last month's forecast); December 2026: 6 kg+ 18.5 %, 5–6 kg 21.6 %.
Check of last forecast for October 2026: 6 kg+ forecast 12.9 %, actual 14.4 %; 5–6 kg forecast 18.1 %, actual 19.4 %.
